test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Their new house costed them _______ hundred and fifty-six thousand pounds.
solution:
The correct answer is "**a**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the indefinite article "**a**" before the** countable nouns**.
 
• In the given sentence, the **pound **is a **noun**; the **number of pounds** is **countable**.
 
• So, we need to use the **indefinite **article "**a**" in the blank.

**The correct sentence is:** *Their new house costed them **a **__hundred and fifty-six thousand pounds.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
